description: This Java class 'LoanCOBFilterHelper' provides utility methods for handling loan-related API requests, including extracting loan IDs from URLs, checking lock statuses, and executing inline loan Close of Business (COB) processes within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: LoanCOBFilterHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing loan COB (Close of Business) operations, including extracting loan IDs from API requests, checking lock statuses, and executing COB processes.

methods.name: getLoanId
methods.description: Extracts the loan ID from the URL path, considering whether it's a GLIM account or a regular loan, and handles external IDs and reschedule requests.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Checks if the URL indicates an external ID based loan.

methods.name: isRescheduleLoans
methods.description: Checks if the URL indicates a reschedule loan request.

methods.name: isOnApiList
methods.description: Determines if the incoming request matches the API patterns managed by this helper.

methods.name: isBatchApiMatching
methods.description: Checks if any batch request within a batch API matches the API patterns.

methods.name: getBatchRequests
methods.description: Parses the request body to extract batch requests and resets the input stream.

methods.name: isApiMatching
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP method and URL path match the expected patterns for loan API calls.

methods.name: isBatchApi
methods.description: Checks if the URL indicates a batch API request.

methods.name: isGlim
methods.description: Checks if the URL indicates a GLIM account loan.

methods.name: isBypassUser
methods.description: Checks if the current user is a bypass user.

methods.name: getGlimChildLoanIds
methods.description: Retrieves child loan IDs associated with a GLIM account.

methods.name: isLoanHardLocked
methods.description: Checks if any of the provided loan IDs are hard locked.

methods.name: isLockOverrulable
methods.description: Checks if any of the provided loan IDs are lock-overridable.

methods.name: isLoanBehind
methods.description: Determines if any of the specified loans are behind on COB date.

methods.name: calculateRelevantLoanIds
methods.description: Calculates and returns relevant loan IDs from the request, handling batch and single API calls.

methods.name: getLoanIdsFromBatchApi
methods.description: Extracts loan IDs from batch API requests, including URL and body analysis.

methods.name: getTopLevelLoanIdFromBatchRequest
methods.description: Extracts the top-level loan ID from a batch request body.

methods.name: getLoanIdsFromApi
methods.description: Gets loan IDs from a URL path, with lock status checks.

methods.name: getLoanIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of loan IDs based on URL analysis, including GLIM accounts.

methods.name: executeInlineCob
methods.description: Triggers execution of inline COB process for specified loan IDs.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectMapper configuration after bean properties are set.
